verdict.rationale: Persona documents recurring scheduled jobs in the form of Reports configured to run at regular intervals (e.g., monthly/yearly Watchlist Reports) and Workflows triggered automatically to automate repetitive decisions, which satisfies a narrow slice of 'recurring jobs' automation. However, this is compliance-report scheduling rather than a general-purpose recurring workflow/job scheduler for AI-native automation use cases. Missing for 10: explicit API/agent-facing scheduling controls (cron-like intervals, arbitrary job types), documentation of workflow trigger types beyond a passing mention, and any AI-native/agent-specific automation tooling.
